assumptions: Geometry, drive delays, belt ramp, and encoder counts-per-metre are inferred demo configuration, not PLC acceptance thresholds.
Carton length 0.30 m, belt speed 0.50 m/s, divert travel 0.35 s, and 0.80 m entry spacing are the specification's suggested visualization defaults, used as tunable world physics only.
No PLC detection deadline, jam timeout, debounce threshold, or late-route acceptance policy is assumed; those remain TBD in the specification.
WCS counting, disposition, alarm, and routing decisions are PLC responsibilities; this world supplies physical truth and raw signals only.

controls.description: Introduce a carton at the entry. Payload: { itemId?: string, requestedRoute?: 'A' | 'B' | 'Unknown' | null }. Placed at position 0 only if entry spacing allows.
Set downstream readiness. Payload: { destination: 'A' | 'B' | 'runout', ready: boolean }.
Suppress or restore actual drive running feedback (drive does not run while suppressed). Payload: { active: boolean }.
Assert or clear simulated drive overload/trip. Payload: { active: boolean }.
Jam or free a divert actuator so it stops moving. Payload: { divert: 1 | 2, active: boolean }.
Force both home and extended raw limits true for a divert, regardless of physical position. Payload: { divert: 1 | 2, active: boolean }.
Hold a photoeye raw value stuck true or false despite physical occupancy. Payload: { signalId: string, active: boolean, value?: boolean }.
Apply rapid bounce to a photoeye raw value for a duration. Payload: { signalId: string, durationMs?: number }.
Jam a carton in place while the belt runs. Payload: { cartonId?: string, active: boolean }.
Clear all injected faults and restore downstream readiness to ready.
